mapper.select: SELECT p.permission FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.available = 1 INNER JOIN sys_data_permission_data p ON p.biz_id = ur.role_id AND p.biz_type = 0 AND p.permission_type = 100 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}
